inputs.name: java_version
inputs.description: Java feature release to install, such as 21 or 25. Every supported distribution packages 25; Fedora 45 packages no other LTS release.

inputs.name: jdk
inputs.description: Install the JDK, with javac and the other development tools, instead of the runtime alone.

inputs.name: java_source
inputs.description: Where Java comes from: "distribution", the distribution's own OpenJDK packages, or "temurin", Eclipse Temurin from Adoptium's repository.

inputs.name: set_default
inputs.description: Make this Java the one `java` runs, through the alternatives system, and export its JAVA_HOME to login shells from /etc/profile.d.
